title: Site social media icons
slide_intent: Show how much empty space a small icon needs around it so adjacent elements do not interrupt its silhouette.
strategic_value: A consistent clearance rule can give each venue icon the same visual standing in shared materials.
demonstration: Six colored icons sit in a measured grid. The clear-space note defines the minimum around each icon as half its width or height.
practical_value: Measure half the icon diameter and reserve that amount of space around a site icon.

content_islands.name: Clear-space explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the scope and half-width rule under the repeated icon section title.

content_islands.name: Icon clearance diagram
content_islands.spec: Arrange the six circles in two rows of three. Extend horizontal and vertical guides into the gaps, and use pale half-circle references to show the spacing unit.
